literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 此外,系统发育分析表明,一小部分(>0.03%)禽类 H5N1 2.3.4.4b 病毒已经携带其中一些 NP 突变。 [10.1128/jvi.01372-26]
提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.1038/s41587-026-03343-6]
在采样的鸟类中,同时存在 H9N2 和沙门氏菌。11/50 中检测到,但没有禽类单独检测出 H9N2 阳性;沙门氏菌属仅在 3/50 的鸟类中检测到。 [10.1007/s11259-026-11587-5]
观察到部分接触 传播,四名接受者中的三名出现感染的临床症状,一名接受者检测到活跃的病毒复制,两名幸存者确认血清转化。 [10.1007/s00705-026-06774-3]
三种 IgG mAb(3CF5、3BG3 和 3BE7)表现出针对多种 H5Nx 病毒的有效中和活性,并在致死小鼠攻击模型中提供保护。值得注意的是,3CF5 在 1997 年至 2024 年期间表现出对 H5Nx 病毒的广泛中和作用。 [10.1016/j.celrep.2026.118180]

The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.1038/s41587-026-03343-6]

Among the sampled birds, concurrent H9N2 and Salmonella spp. were detected in 11/50, while no birds were positive for H9N2 alone; Salmonella spp. alone was detected in 3/50 birds. [10.1007/s11259-026-11587-5]

Partial contact transmission was observed, with clinical signs of infection developing in three of four recipients, active viral replication detected in one, and seroconversion confirmed in two survivors. [10.1007/s00705-026-06774-3]

Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, demonstrated potent neutralizing activity against multiple H5Nx viruses and conferred protection in a lethal mouse challenge model. Notably, 3CF5 exhibited broad neutralization against H5Nx viruses spanning 1997-2024. [10.1016/j.celrep.2026.118180]

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 文章报道了澳大利亚南极计划的活动,包括补给行动、建设项目和科学任务,但没有提及任何确诊或疑似 禽流感 病例或相关健康事件。 [news-6177124311bf25e8]
科学家们在 H9N2 禽流感 病毒的血凝素蛋白上鉴定并绘制了两个新的线性 B 细胞表位,它们是保守的、表面暴露的且针对该亚型。 [news-d38c635e29679d28]
H5N1 高致病性禽流感 在爱荷华州萨克县的商业火鸡群中得到证实,引发金·雷诺兹 (Kim Reynolds) 宣布州灾难。 [news-b675282a59e7b6c4]
对犹他州水貂养殖场的禽流感基因测序显示,每个样本中都含有 突变,这在西班牙 2022 年水貂中也出现了 暴发。由于抱怨烦扰,犹他州官员停止了对农场工人的主动监控,该州也没有计划扑杀水貂。这是一份初步的基因组报告,并未证实 突变 对人类健康的影响。 [news-79ef3e0bfd7b61a7]
H5N1 禽流感 病毒正在引发一场大流行,在对秃鹫至关重要的地区广泛传播并威胁其种群。正如《保护生物学》发表的一封信中所记录的那样,该事件得到了研究人员和保护主义者的证实。 [news-bb8d0ffc4533fa1b]

news.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses news
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Avian influenza A viruses news developments.
key_findings_en: The article reports on the Australian Antarctic Program's activities, including resupply operations, construction projects, and scientific missions, without mentioning any confirmed or suspected cases of avian influenza or related health events. [news-6177124311bf25e8]

Scientists identified and mapped two new linear B-cell epitopes on the hemagglutinin protein of H9N2 avian influenza virus, which are conserved, surface-exposed, and specific to this subtype. [news-d38c635e29679d28]
H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza was confirmed in a commercial turkey flock in Sac County, Iowa, triggering a state disaster declaration by Kim Reynolds. [news-b675282a59e7b6c4]

Genetic sequencing of bird flu from a Utah mink farm revealed a mutation in every sample that is also seen in Spain's 2022 mink outbreak. Utah officials halted active monitoring of farm workers due to complaints about annoyance, and the state has no plans to cull the mink population. [news-79ef3e0bfd7b61a7]

The H5N1 avian influenza virus is causing a panzootic, spreading widely in regions critical for vultures and threatening their populations. The event is confirmed by researchers and conservationists, as documented in a letter published in Conservation Biology. [news-bb8d0ffc4533fa1b]

H5N1 高致病性禽流感 在爱荷华州萨克县的商业火鸡群中得到证实,引发金·雷诺兹 (Kim Reynolds) 宣布州灾难。 [news-b675282a59e7b6c4]。
对犹他州水貂养殖场的禽流感基因测序显示,每个样本中都含有 突变,这在西班牙 2022 年水貂中也出现了 暴发。由于抱怨烦扰,犹他州官员停止了对农场工人的主动监控,该州也没有计划扑杀水貂。这是一份初步的基因组报告,并未证实 突变 对人类健康的影响。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following Avian influenza A viruses news developments.

The article reports on the Australian Antarctic Program's activities, including resupply operations, construction projects, and scientific missions, without mentioning any confirmed or suspected cases of avian influenza or related health events.

Scientists identified and mapped two new linear B-cell epitopes on the hemagglutinin protein of H9N2 avian influenza virus, which are conserved, surface-exposed, and specific to this subtype. [news-d38c635e29679d28].
H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza was confirmed in a commercial turkey flock in Sac County, Iowa, triggering a state disaster declaration by Kim Reynolds. [news-b675282a59e7b6c4].
Genetic sequencing of bird flu from a Utah mink farm revealed a mutation in every sample that is also seen in Spain's 2022 mink outbreak.

papers.title: Bovine myxovirus resistance protein (Mx)1, but not Mx2, mediates antiviral activity against human and avian influenza A viruses, including H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses have recently infected dairy cows in the United States, raising concerns about human spillover. The antiviral roles of bovine host defense factors, including myxovirus resistance proteins (bMx1 and bMx2), remain relatively understudied. We examined bMx1/bMx2 induction in differentiated bovine cells following HPAI H5N1 infection and assessed their antiviral activity using overexpression, knockdown, and mutagenesis approaches. Both bMx1 and bMx2 were more strongly induced in mammary cells than in tracheal cells. Overexpression of bMx1, but not bMx2, significantly inhibited seasonal influenza A viruses (IAVs), low-pathogenic, and highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, including H5N1 2.3.4.4b, but not influenza B viruses. Conversely, knockdown of bMx1 resulted in enhanced IAV growth. Further, bMx1 inhibited early stages of viral replication, acting to reduce viral transcription and subsequent steps in the viral replication cycle. Known mutations that reduce human MxA (hMxA) activity also impaired bMx1 function, and mutations in the viral nucleoprotein (NP) associated with resistance to hMxA also reduced virus sensitivity to bMx1. Furthermore, phylogenetic analysis showed that a small minority (>0.03%) of avian H5N1 2.3.4.4b viruses already carry some of these NP mutations. These findings suggest that while current H5N1 viruses largely remain susceptible to bMx1, viral evolution or opportunistic reassortment could drive Mx resistance and increase pandemic risk. IMPORTANCE Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses have spilled over into dairy cows and have been circulating on dairy farms in the United States since 2024. The innate antiviral immune responses of cows to influenza viruses have not been extensively studied. In this study, we focused on Mx proteins, a key part of the innate immune defense system toward viruses. We specifically looked at bovine Mx proteins and demonstrated antiviral activity toward different influenza viruses, including the highly pathogenic strains. We also showed that the mechanism of antiviral activity of bovine Mx1 was very similar to that of the human equivalent MxA protein. Further, we found that a small minority of these avian viruses have mutations associated with resistance to both bovine Mx1 and human MxA proteins. Overall, this work highlights the elevated pandemic risk for highly pathogenic influenza viruses through continual circulation in cows, a mammalian species in close proximity to humans.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒最近感染了美国的奶牛,引起了对人类 跨物种溢出 的担忧。牛 宿主 防御因子(包括粘病毒抗性蛋白(bMx1 和 bMx2))的 抗病毒药物 作用仍相对未得到充分研究。我们检测了 HPAI H5N1 感染后分化牛细胞中 bMx1/bMx2 的诱导,并使用过表达、敲低和诱变方法评估了它们的 抗病毒药物 活性。bMx1 和 bMx2 在乳腺细胞中的诱导作用比在气管细胞中的诱导作用更强。bMx1 而非 bMx2 的过表达可显着抑制季节性甲型流感病毒 (IAV)、低致病性和 高致病性禽流感 病毒,包括 H5N1 2.3.4.4b,但不能抑制乙型流感病毒。相反,bMx1 的敲低导致 IAV 生长增强。此外,bMx1 抑制病毒复制的早期阶段,从而减少病毒转录和病毒复制周期的后续步骤。已知的 突变 可以降低人类 MxA (hMxA) 活性,同时也会损害 bMx1 功能,而与 hMxA 抗性相关的病毒核蛋白 (NP) 中的 突变 也会降低病毒对 bMx1 的敏感性。此外,系统发育分析表明,一小部分(>0.03%)禽类 H5N1 2.3.4.4b 病毒已经携带其中一些 NP 突变。这些发现表明,虽然当前的 H5N1 病毒在很大程度上仍然对 bMx1 敏感,但病毒 进化 或机会性重配可能会导致 Mx 耐药性并增加大流行风险。重要性 高致病性禽流感 病毒已扩散到奶牛中,并自 2024 年以来一直在美国奶牛场传播。奶牛对流感病毒的先天 抗病毒药物 免疫应答 尚未得到广泛研究。在这项研究中,我们重点关注 Mx 蛋白,它是针对病毒的先天免疫防御系统的关键部分。我们专门研究了牛 Mx 蛋白,并证明了 抗病毒药物 对不同流感病毒(包括高致病性毒株)的活性。我们还表明,牛 Mx1 的 抗病毒药物 活性机制与人类等效的 MxA 蛋白非常相似。此外,我们发现这些禽类病毒中的一小部分具有与牛 Mx1 和人 MxA 蛋白抗性相关的 突变。总体而言,这项工作强调了高致病性流感病毒通过在牛(一种与人类关系密切的哺乳动物物种)中持续传播而增加的大流行风险。

papers.title: Divide and reduce: systematic review and mathematical modelling of the impact of within-farm compartmentalisation on avian influenza transmission in poultry
papers.abstract: 150-200 words): Airborne transmission of avian influenza viruses (AIVs) is animportant transmission route among domestic poultry, but less effective than the classical faecal-oral route.Therefore, flock compartmentalisation, consisting in physically separating birds into groups, is expected to reduce the spread of AIVs in poultry.In this study, we quantified the impact of compartmentalisation on within-flock AIV spread by (i) performing a systematic review of transmission experiments studying airborne transmission of AIVs and(ii) reanalysing the data from 30 experiments in 13 eligible studies with mathematical models.When compared to transmission between birds in the same pen, between-pen transmission was systematically reduced for highly pathogenic AIVs (median reduction: 96%, min: 83%max: 100%).For low pathogenicity AIVs, 22/26 estimates indicated a reduced between-pen transmission, but results ranged from 100% reduction to 160% increase.Estimated parameters were then used in a deterministic mechanistic model to illustrate the potential impact of compartmentalisation on highly pathogenic AIVs transmission in field conditions, showing https://doi.org/10.

papers.title: mRNA vaccine encoding multimerized AIV-M2e fused to MHC-II invariant chain motif and Pan-DR epitope confers protection against H9N2 virus in chickens
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) remain a major threat to global poultry health and production. The risk of cross-species transmission among diverse AIV subtypes poses a significant challenge to disease control, underscoring the need for vaccines that provide broad and durable protection. However, existing inactivated and vector-based vaccines provide limited cross-subtype coverage and durable immunity against antigenically diverse AIVs. In contrast, the success of mRNA vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 has accelerated vaccine development by enabling rapid, flexible, and scalable vaccine design compared with conventional platforms. We designed an mRNA vaccine encoding four tandem repeats of the conserved influenza M2 ectodomain (4xM2e), fused to the chicken invariant chain (Ii) motif and a 13-amino-acid universal Pan-DR-binding epitope (PADRE). We hypothesized that this design would enhance anti-M2e antibody responses while promoting efficient antigen processing and CD4 + T-helper cell activation, thereby inducing systemic and mucosal immunity against AIV infection in chickens. The mRNA construct was delivered via standard lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), and vaccine efficacy was evaluated following intramuscular (IM) and intranasal (IN) administration. Our data demonstrated a modest increase in systemic and mucosal antibody responses, accompanied by enhanced T-cell proliferation and increased CD4 + and γδ + T-cell populations. Following challenge with A/turkey/Wisconsin/1/1966/H9N2 virus, vaccinated birds exhibited significantly reduced viral shedding regardless of the route of administration. Histopathological analysis further demonstrated largely preserved pulmonary architecture with minimal inflammation, demonstrating effective maintenance of mucosal barrier integrity. To assess the cross-protective potential and functional activity of anti-M2e antibodies, we demonstrated in vitro heterosubtypic recognition of PR8/H1N1 and confirmed their functional relevance by antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). Together, our findings demonstrate that the present mRNA vaccine construct, encoding a structurally optimized multimerized M2e protein fused to PADRE and the Ii motif, represents a safe and effective vaccine strategy with the potential to confer broad protective immunity against AIV infection in chickens.

papers.title_zh: 编码多聚化 AIV-M2e 的 mRNA 疫苗 与 MHC-II 不变链基序和 Pan-DR 表位融合,赋予鸡针对 H9N2 病毒的保护作用
papers.source_body_en: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) remain a major threat to global poultry health and production. The risk of cross-species transmission among diverse AIV subtypes poses a significant challenge to disease control, underscoring the need for vaccines that provide broad and durable protection. However, existing inactivated and vector-based vaccines provide limited cross-subtype coverage and durable immunity against antigenically diverse AIVs. In contrast, the success of mRNA vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 has accelerated vaccine development by enabling rapid, flexible, and scalable vaccine design compared with conventional platforms. We designed an mRNA vaccine encoding four tandem repeats of the conserved influenza M2 ectodomain (4xM2e), fused to the chicken invariant chain (Ii) motif and a 13-amino-acid universal Pan-DR-binding epitope (PADRE). We hypothesized that this design would enhance anti-M2e antibody responses while promoting efficient antigen processing and CD4 + T-helper cell activation, thereby inducing systemic and mucosal immunity against AIV infection in chickens. The mRNA construct was delivered via standard lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), and vaccine efficacy was evaluated following intramuscular (IM) and intranasal (IN) administration. Our data demonstrated a modest increase in systemic and mucosal antibody responses, accompanied by enhanced T-cell proliferation and increased CD4 + and γδ + T-cell populations. Following challenge with A/turkey/Wisconsin/1/1966/H9N2 virus, vaccinated birds exhibited significantly reduced viral shedding regardless of the route of administration. Histopathological analysis further demonstrated largely preserved pulmonary architecture with minimal inflammation, demonstrating effective maintenance of mucosal barrier integrity. To assess the cross-protective potential and functional activity of anti-M2e antibodies, we demonstrated in vitro heterosubtypic recognition of PR8/H1N1 and confirmed their functional relevance by antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). Together, our findings demonstrate that the present mRNA vaccine construct, encoding a structurally optimized multimerized M2e protein fused to PADRE and the Ii motif, represents a safe and effective vaccine strategy with the potential to confer broad protective immunity against AIV infection in chickens.
papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 仍然是全球家禽健康和生产的主要威胁。不同AIV亚型之间的跨物种传播风险对疾病控制构成了重大挑战,这凸显了对提供广泛而持久保护的疫苗的需求。然而,现有的灭活和基于 媒介 的 疫苗 提供有限的跨亚型覆盖和针对抗原多样化 AIV 的持久免疫力。相比之下,与传统平台相比,针对 SARS-CoV-2 的 mRNA 疫苗 的成功通过实现快速、灵活和可扩展的 疫苗 设计,加速了 疫苗 的开发。我们设计了一个 mRNA 疫苗,编码保守的流感 M2 胞外域 (4xM2e) 的四个串联重复,与鸡不变链 (Ii) 基序和 13 个氨基酸通用 Pan-DR 结合表位 (PADRE) 融合。我们假设这种设计将增强抗 M2e 抗体反应,同时促进有效的抗原加工和 CD4 + T 辅助细胞激活,从而诱导鸡针对 AIV 感染的全身和粘膜免疫。mRNA 构建体通过标准脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 递送,并在肌内 (IM) 和鼻内 (IN) 给药后评估 疫苗 功效。我们的数据表明,全身和粘膜抗体反应适度增加,同时 T 细胞增殖增强,CD4 + 和 γδ + T 细胞群增加。在用 A/turkey/Wisconsin/1/1966/H9N2 病毒攻击后,无论采用何种给药途径,接种疫苗的禽类均表现出病毒脱落显着减少。组织病理学分析进一步证明肺结构基本保留且炎症最小,证明了粘膜屏障完整性的有效维持。为了评估抗 M2e 抗体的交叉保护潜力和功能活性,我们证明了 PR8/H1N1 的体外异亚型识别,并通过抗体依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC) 证实了它们的功能相关性。总之,我们的研究结果表明,目前的 mRNA 疫苗 构建体编码与 PADRE 和 Ii 基序融合的结构优化的多聚化 M2e 蛋白,代表了一种安全有效的 疫苗 策略,有可能赋予鸡针对 AIV 感染的广泛保护性免疫力。

papers.title: Influenza A virus H5Nx genotypes assigned by genetic similarity are incongruent with global phylogenies
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus H5N1 and other H5 subtypes (H5Nx) have broad host ranges and pose a pandemic risk. Since early 2022, H5 clade 2.3.4.4b has predominated globally, causing unprecedented mortality in wild birds, poultry, and mammals, with spillovers to humans. Accurate viral classification is essential for tracking H5Nx variant emergence and spread, but reassortment among genome segments with distinct evolutionary histories complicates genotyping. H5Nx genotype assignment tools, GenoFlu in North America and Genin2 in Europe, assign segments to clusters by genetic similarity to reference sequences and define genotypes as constellations of segment clusters. However, genetic similarity does not necessarily imply recent shared ancestry because mutations may occur multiple times across the tree and branches may exhibit variable evolutionary rates. Furthermore, similarity is defined relative to references that may inadequately represent diversity. We evaluated the congruence of genetic similarity-based H5Nx clusters and genotypes with phylogenies of global sequences across eight segments. Publicly available H5Nx nucleotide sequences from 41,366 samples were assigned genotypes using GenoFlu and Genin2, and maximum likelihood phylogenies were inferred for each segment. Phylogenetic clusters were identified using TreeCluster for a range of patristic distance thresholds and CD-HIT clusters were identified for a range of genetic similarity thresholds. Clustering methods were evaluated based on phylogenetic purity, monophyly, and diversity. Reassortment within predominant GenoFlu and Genin2 genotypes was evaluated based on their phylogenetic cluster spans. Expectedly, GenoFlu was largely unable to assign genomes from outside of North America, South America, and Antarctica from 2022 to 2025, whereas Genin2 assignments struggled outside of Europe, Africa, and Western Asia. Only 14.2% of GenoFlu clusters were monophyletic, while Genin2 clusters were more variable across segments (overall 49.3% monophyletic). Despite CD-HIT yielding genetic distance clusters of similar size to TreeCluster, they were less monophyletic (44%) and encompassed greater phylogenetic diversity. We identified several genotypes, such as GenoFlu B3.13, D1.1, and D1.3, with internal segments that had diversified into contiguous clusters. Similarly, the wide phylogenetic span of GenoFlu genotypes B3.5 and A3, and Genin2 genotypes EA-2020-C, EA-2021-AB, and EA-2022-CH suggest they may erroneously combine multiple reassortants. Genetic similarity-based H5Nx genotyping tools are rapid, stable, and sufficient for broad categorization, but may group viruses with distinct evolutionary histories and fail to assign divergent viruses, risking biased surveillance, modeling, and risk assessment.

Since early 2022, H5 clade 2.3.4.4b has predominated globally, causing unprecedented mortality in wild birds, poultry, and mammals, with spillovers to humans. Accurate viral classification is essential for tracking H5Nx variant emergence and spread, but reassortment among genome segments with distinct evolutionary histories complicates genotyping. H5Nx genotype assignment tools, GenoFlu in North America and Genin2 in Europe, assign segments to clusters by genetic similarity to reference sequences and define genotypes as constellations of segment clusters. However, genetic similarity does not necessarily imply recent shared ancestry because mutations may occur multiple times across the tree and branches may exhibit variable evolutionary rates. Furthermore, similarity is defined relative to references that may inadequately represent diversity. We evaluated the congruence of genetic similarity-based H5Nx clusters and genotypes with phylogenies of global sequences across eight segments. Publicly available H5Nx nucleotide sequences from 41,366 samples were assigned genotypes using GenoFlu and Genin2, and maximum likelihood phylogenies were inferred for each segment. Phylogenetic clusters were identified using TreeCluster for a range of patristic distance thresholds and CD-HIT clusters were identified for a range of genetic similarity thresholds. Clustering methods were evaluated based on phylogenetic purity, monophyly, and diversity. Reassortment within predominant GenoFlu and Genin2 genotypes was evaluated based on their phylogenetic cluster spans. Expectedly, GenoFlu was largely unable to assign genomes from outside of North America, South America, and Antarctica from 2022 to 2025, whereas Genin2 assignments struggled outside of Europe, Africa, and Western Asia. Only 14.2% of GenoFlu clusters were monophyletic, while Genin2 clusters were more variable across segments (overall 49.3% monophyletic). Despite CD-HIT yielding genetic distance clusters of similar size to TreeCluster, they were less monophyletic (44%) and encompassed greater phylogenetic diversity. We identified several genotypes, such as GenoFlu B3.13, D1.1, and D1.3, with internal segments that had diversified into contiguous clusters. Similarly, the wide phylogenetic span of GenoFlu genotypes B3.5 and A3, and Genin2 genotypes EA-2020-C, EA-2021-AB, and EA-2022-CH suggest they may erroneously combine multiple reassortants. Genetic similarity-based H5Nx genotyping tools are rapid, stable, and sufficient for broad categorization, but may group viruses with distinct evolutionary histories and fail to assign divergent viruses, risking biased surveillance, modeling, and risk assessment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Influenza A virus H5Nx genotypes assigned by genetic similarity may not align with global phylogenies, as these viruses have broad host ranges and pose a pandemic risk.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the congruence of genetic similarity-based H5Nx clusters and genotypes with phylogenies of global sequences across eight segments using publicly available H5Nx nucleotide sequences from 41,366 samples.
analysis.methods: Genotypes were assigned using GenoFlu and Genin2 based on genetic similarity to reference sequences, and phylogenetic clusters were identified using TreeCluster and CD-HIT with varying patristic distance and genetic similarity thresholds.
analysis.main_results: GenoFlu clusters showed low monophyly (14.2%), while Genin2 clusters were more variable (49.3% overall monophyletic). CD-HIT clusters were less monophyletic (44%) and included greater phylogenetic diversity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that genetic similarity-based genotyping may group viruses with distinct evolutionary histories and fail to assign divergent viruses, potentially leading to biased surveillance and risk assessment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results caution against over-reliance on genetic similarity-based genotyping for tracking H5Nx variants, as it may obscure true evolutionary relationships and hinder accurate risk assessment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on publicly available sequences and the inherent challenges of genetic similarity-based classification, which may not capture recent shared ancestry due to variable mutation rates and evolutionary histories.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the congruence of genetic similarity-based H5Nx genotypes with global phylogenies, highlighting the limitations of current classification tools. The research reveals that H5Nx genotypes, such as GenoFlu B3.13, D1.1, and D1.3, and Genin2 EA-2020-C, EA-2021-AB, and EA-2022-CH, may include segments with distinct evolutionary histories, suggesting potential inaccuracies in grouping. The study underscores the importance of phylogenetic analysis for accurate surveillance and risk assessment, as genetic similarity alone may not reflect recent ancestry. While the methods used are robust, the reliance on reference sequences and the variability in mutation rates across segments limit the confidence in the classification. These findings have significant implications for the interpretation of H5Nx genotypes in global tracking efforts.

papers.title_zh: 根据遗传相似性分配的甲型流感病毒 H5Nx 基因型与全球系统发育不一致
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus H5N1 and other H5 subtypes (H5Nx) have broad host ranges and pose a pandemic risk. Since early 2022, H5 clade 2.3.4.4b has predominated globally, causing unprecedented mortality in wild birds, poultry, and mammals, with spillovers to humans. Accurate viral classification is essential for tracking H5Nx variant emergence and spread, but reassortment among genome segments with distinct evolutionary histories complicates genotyping. H5Nx genotype assignment tools, GenoFlu in North America and Genin2 in Europe, assign segments to clusters by genetic similarity to reference sequences and define genotypes as constellations of segment clusters. However, genetic similarity does not necessarily imply recent shared ancestry because mutations may occur multiple times across the tree and branches may exhibit variable evolutionary rates. Furthermore, similarity is defined relative to references that may inadequately represent diversity. We evaluated the congruence of genetic similarity-based H5Nx clusters and genotypes with phylogenies of global sequences across eight segments. Publicly available H5Nx nucleotide sequences from 41,366 samples were assigned genotypes using GenoFlu and Genin2, and maximum likelihood phylogenies were inferred for each segment. Phylogenetic clusters were identified using TreeCluster for a range of patristic distance thresholds and CD-HIT clusters were identified for a range of genetic similarity thresholds. Clustering methods were evaluated based on phylogenetic purity, monophyly, and diversity. Reassortment within predominant GenoFlu and Genin2 genotypes was evaluated based on their phylogenetic cluster spans. Expectedly, GenoFlu was largely unable to assign genomes from outside of North America, South America, and Antarctica from 2022 to 2025, whereas Genin2 assignments struggled outside of Europe, Africa, and Western Asia. Only 14.2% of GenoFlu clusters were monophyletic, while Genin2 clusters were more variable across segments (overall 49.3% monophyletic). Despite CD-HIT yielding genetic distance clusters of similar size to TreeCluster, they were less monophyletic (44%) and encompassed greater phylogenetic diversity. We identified several genotypes, such as GenoFlu B3.13, D1.1, and D1.3, with internal segments that had diversified into contiguous clusters. Similarly, the wide phylogenetic span of GenoFlu genotypes B3.5 and A3, and Genin2 genotypes EA-2020-C, EA-2021-AB, and EA-2022-CH suggest they may erroneously combine multiple reassortants. Genetic similarity-based H5Nx genotyping tools are rapid, stable, and sufficient for broad categorization, but may group viruses with distinct evolutionary histories and fail to assign divergent viruses, risking biased surveillance, modeling, and risk assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒 H5N1 和其他 H5 亚型 (H5Nx) 具有广泛的 宿主 范围,并构成大流行风险。自2022年初以来,H5进化枝2.3.4.4b在全球范围内占据主导地位,在野生鸟类、家禽和哺乳动物中造成前所未有的死亡率,对人类也造成了跨物种溢出。准确的病毒分类对于追踪 H5Nx 变异的出现和传播至关重要,但具有不同进化历史的 基因组 片段之间的重排使基因分型变得复杂。H5Nx 基因型分配工具(北美的 GenoFlu 和欧洲的 Genin2)根据与参考序列的遗传相似性将片段分配给簇,并将基因型定义为片段簇的星座。然而,遗传相似性并不一定意味着最近的共同祖先,因为 突变 可能在树上多次出现,并且分支可能表现出不同的进化速率。此外,相似性是相对于可能不足以代表多样性的参考文献来定义的。我们评估了基于遗传相似性的 H5Nx 簇和基因型与八个片段的全局序列的系统发育的一致性。使用 GenoFlu 和 Genin2 对来自 41,366 个样本的公开 H5Nx 核苷酸序列进行基因型分配,并推断每个片段的最大似然系统发育。使用 TreeCluster 识别一系列父系距离阈值的系统发育簇,并使用一系列遗传相似性阈值识别 CD-HIT 簇。聚类方法根据系统发育纯度、单系性和多样性进行评估。主要 GenoFlu 和 Genin2 基因型内的重配根据其系统发育簇跨度进行评估。预计,从 2022 年到 2025 年,GenoFlu 基本上无法从北美、南美和南极洲以外的地区分配 基因组,而 Genin2 在欧洲、非洲和西亚以外的地区分配则很困难。只有 14.2% 的 GenoFlu 簇是单系的,而 Genin2 簇在各个区段之间变化更大(总体而言,49.3% 是单系的)。尽管 CD-HIT 产生的遗传距离簇与 TreeCluster 大小相似,但它们的单系性较低 (44%),并且包含更大的系统发育多样性。我们鉴定了几种基因型,例如 GenoFlu B3.13、D1.1 和 D1.3,其内部片段已多样化为连续的簇。同样,GenoFlu 基因型 B3.5 和 A3 以及 Genin2 基因型 EA-2020-C、EA-2021-AB 和 EA-2022-CH 的广泛系统发育跨度表明它们可能错误地组合了多个重配体。基于遗传相似性的 H5Nx 基因分型工具快速、稳定且足以进行广泛的分类,但可能会对具有不同进化历史的病毒进行分组,而无法分配不同的病毒,从而存在 监测、建模和风险评估存在偏见的风险。

papers.title: Contact transmission of fur seal-derived genotype A3 influenza A(H5N1) virus in ferrets
papers.abstract: The global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus of clade 2.3.4.4b is accompanied by an increasing frequency of cross-species transmission events to mammals. In 2023, a mass epizootic among northern fur seals (Callorhinus ursinus) was recorded in the Russian Far East, associated with genotype A3 carrying the adaptive substitutions PB2-K482R and NP-N319K. The virus demonstrated high virulence in both mice and ferrets. To evaluate the transmissive potential of this reassortant, we experimentally investigated its capacity for contact transmission in a ferret animal model. Partial contact transmission was observed during co-housing with naïve animals: clinical signs of infection developed in three of four recipients, active viral replication was detected in one, and seroconversion was confirmed in two survivors. Potential de novo mammalian-adaptative mutation NS-I81T was detected in the virus from an infected donor ferret. This study provides the first experimental evidence of contact transmission capability among mammals for a clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) isolate of genotype A3, correlating with the presence of specific molecular markers of adaptation. These findings underscore the necessity of prioritizing functional and genomic surveillance of circulating variants to enable timely assessment of their zoonotic risk and potential for sustained cross-species circulation.

papers.title_zh: 雪貂体内毛皮海豹衍生的基因型 A3 甲型流感 (H5N1) 病毒的接触 传播
papers.source_body_en: The global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus of clade 2.3.4.4b is accompanied by an increasing frequency of cross-species transmission events to mammals. In 2023, a mass epizootic among northern fur seals (Callorhinus ursinus) was recorded in the Russian Far East, associated with genotype A3 carrying the adaptive substitutions PB2-K482R and NP-N319K. The virus demonstrated high virulence in both mice and ferrets. To evaluate the transmissive potential of this reassortant, we experimentally investigated its capacity for contact transmission in a ferret animal model. Partial contact transmission was observed during co-housing with naïve animals: clinical signs of infection developed in three of four recipients, active viral replication was detected in one, and seroconversion was confirmed in two survivors. Potential de novo mammalian-adaptative mutation NS-I81T was detected in the virus from an infected donor ferret. This study provides the first experimental evidence of contact transmission capability among mammals for a clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) isolate of genotype A3, correlating with the presence of specific molecular markers of adaptation. These findings underscore the necessity of prioritizing functional and genomic surveillance of circulating variants to enable timely assessment of their zoonotic risk and potential for sustained cross-species circulation.

papers.title: An mRNA–lipid nanoparticle vaccine against H5N1 influenza virus protects lactating dairy cows from infection
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 virus has recently emerged in dairy cattle in the USA, leading to mastitis and sharp reductions in milk production. The main site of H5N1 viral replication is the mammary tissue rather than the respiratory tract and viral transmission between animals is thought to occur through viral shedding in milk. Here, we generate an mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine encoding the hemagglutinin (HA) of A/dairy cattle/Texas/24-008749-002/2024, representative of circulating bovine H5N1 viruses, and assess its immunogenicity and efficacy in lactating dairy cows. Eight cows were divided into vaccinated and control groups, receiving two intramuscular doses of the vaccine or saline, followed by intramammary viral challenge. Vaccination elicited HA-reactive and neutralizing antibodies in serum and HA-reactive antibodies in milk. Following viral challenge, vaccinated cows had ~1,000-fold lower peak viral RNA in milk and a lower occurrence of mastitis and mammary fibrosis.

papers.title_zh: 针对 H5N1 流感病毒的 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒 疫苗 可保护泌乳奶牛免受感染
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 virus has recently emerged in dairy cattle in the USA, leading to mastitis and sharp reductions in milk production. The main site of H5N1 viral replication is the mammary tissue rather than the respiratory tract and viral transmission between animals is thought to occur through viral shedding in milk. Here, we generate an mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine encoding the hemagglutinin (HA) of A/dairy cattle/Texas/24-008749-002/2024, representative of circulating bovine H5N1 viruses, and assess its immunogenicity and efficacy in lactating dairy cows. Eight cows were divided into vaccinated and control groups, receiving two intramuscular doses of the vaccine or saline, followed by intramammary viral challenge. Vaccination elicited HA-reactive and neutralizing antibodies in serum and HA-reactive antibodies in milk. Following viral challenge, vaccinated cows had ~1,000-fold lower peak viral RNA in milk and a lower occurrence of mastitis and mammary fibrosis.

papers.title: SARS, H1N1, EBOLA, COVID-19, MPOX, H5N1 AND HANTAVIRUS: IS HUMANITY ENTERING A NEW ERA OF PANDEMIC? IS TÜRKİYE PREPARED FOR THE NEXT GLOBAL OUTBREAK?
papers.abstract: The emergence and re-emergence of infectious diseases pose persistent challenges to global health security. Outbreaks such as severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), influenza A(H1N1), Ebola virus disease, coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), mpox, avian influenza A(H5N1), and hantavirus infections highlight the need for effective preparedness against emerging infectious threats. The concept of “Disease X” further emphasizes the importance of preparing for unknown pathogens that may cause future epidemics or pandemics. This study aimed to examine major infectious disease outbreaks and assess Türkiye’s preparedness for potential future global outbreaks. A descriptive review design was employed, based on a structured literature search and document analysis of scientific publications and institutional reports. The findings were organized and interpreted using a SWOT framework. The analysis identified healthcare infrastructure, intensive care capacity, digital health systems, and experience gained during the COVID-19 pandemic as potential strengths. However, challenges related to healthcare workforce capacity, zoonotic disease surveillance, public health literacy, coordination across human, animal, and environmental health sectors, and dependence on external sources for certain biotechnological products may constrain preparedness. Climate change, environmental disruption, international travel, migration, and global trade were identified as factors that may influence the emergence and spread of infectious diseases. Strengthening integrated surveillance and early warning systems, improving intersectoral coordination through the One Health approach, enhancing domestic vaccine and diagnostic production capacity, and expanding community-based public health education may help improve Türkiye’s preparedness for future outbreaks. These findings highlight the importance of sustained, multisectoral preparedness for emerging infectious disease threats.
papers.journal: International Journal of Health Services Research and Policy

The concept of “Disease X” further emphasizes the importance of preparing for unknown pathogens that may cause future epidemics or pandemics. This study aimed to examine major infectious disease outbreaks and assess Türkiye’s preparedness for potential future global outbreaks. Climate change, environmental disruption, international travel, migration, and global trade were identified as factors that may influence the emergence and spread of infectious diseases. These findings highlight the importance of sustained, multisectoral preparedness for emerging infectious disease threats.

papers.title: Antibody 3CF5 neutralizes historical and emerging H5Nx influenza viruses by targeting a conserved non-receptor-binding hemagglutinin epitope
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses of the H5Nx subtype pose persistent pandemic threats. Here, we immunized rhesus macaques with an H5N6 vaccine and obtained 30 H5-reactive monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, demonstrated potent neutralizing activity against multiple H5Nx viruses and conferred protection in a lethal mouse challenge model. Notably, 3CF5 exhibited broad neutralization against H5Nx viruses spanning 1997-2024, including contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 strains associated with an ongoing outbreak in dairy cattle. Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) analysis revealed that 3CF5 targets a conserved non-receptor-binding epitope on the hemagglutinin (HA) head, spanning the vestigial esterase domain and an adjacent lateral surface. 3CF5 mediates neutralization primarily through inhibiting membrane fusion and also possesses antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity. Furthermore, isotype conversion of 3CF5-IgG to mucosal secretory IgA1 (sIgA1) enhanced neutralization potency against H5N1 viruses up to 128-fold, highlighting the advantage of sIgA1 as a nasally administered prophylactic agent.

These mAbs were then tested against multiple H5Nx viruses, including contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 strains associated with an ongoing outbreak in dairy cattle.
analysis.methods: Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, were tested for neutralizing activity against H5Nx viruses. Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) analysis was used to determine the epitope targeted by 3CF5, and isotype conversion to mucosal secretory IgA1 (sIgA1) was evaluated for enhanced neutralization potency.
analysis.main_results: Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, demonstrated potent neutralizing activity against multiple H5Nx viruses and conferred protection in a lethal mouse challenge model. Notably, 3CF5 exhibited broad neutralization against H5Nx viruses spanning 1997-2024.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the potential of 3CF5 as a broad-spectrum neutralizing antibody against H5Nx viruses, including emerging strains. The study introduces a novel mechanism of neutralization through targeting a conserved non-receptor-binding epitope on the hemagglutinin (HA) head.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that 3CF5 could be a valuable tool for developing vaccines and therapeutic agents against H5Nx influenza viruses, particularly those associated with ongoing outbreaks in livestock.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully represent real-world conditions. analysis.summary_en: This study identifies 3CF5, a monoclonal antibody that neutralizes a wide range of H5Nx influenza viruses, including emerging strains. The research involved immunizing rhesus macaques with an H5N6 vaccine and testing the resulting antibodies against multiple H5Nx viruses. Cryo-electron microscopy revealed that 3CF5 targets a conserved non-receptor-binding epitope on the hemagglutinin (HA) head, and its conversion to mucosal secretory IgA1 (sIgA1) significantly enhanced neutralization potency. The findings suggest that 3CF5 could be a promising candidate for vaccines and prophylactic agents against H5Nx viruses, particularly those linked to outbreaks in dairy cattle. While the study provides moderate confidence through in vitro and in vivo models, it does not fully replicate real-world conditions.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Avian influenza viruses of the H5Nx subtype pose persistent pandemic threats. This study aimed to identify antibodies that could neutralize these viruses effectively.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved immunizing rhesus macaques with an H5N6 vaccine and obtaining 30 H5-reactive monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). analysis_en.main_results: Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, demonstrated potent neutralizing activity against multiple H5Nx viruses and conferred protection in a lethal mouse challenge model. Notably, 3CF5 exhibited broad neutralization against H5Nx viruses spanning 1997-2024.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the potential of 3CF5 as a broad-spectrum neutralizing antibody against H5Nx viruses, including emerging strains. analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that 3CF5 could be a valuable tool for developing vaccines and therapeutic agents against H5Nx influenza viruses, particularly those associated with ongoing outbreaks in livestock.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully represent real-world conditions. papers.source_body_en: Avian influenza viruses of the H5Nx subtype pose persistent pandemic threats. Here, we immunized rhesus macaques with an H5N6 vaccine and obtained 30 H5-reactive monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). Three IgG mAbs, 3CF5, 3BG3, and 3BE7, demonstrated potent neutralizing activity against multiple H5Nx viruses and conferred protection in a lethal mouse challenge model. Notably, 3CF5 exhibited broad neutralization against H5Nx viruses spanning 1997-2024, including contemporary clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 strains associated with an ongoing outbreak in dairy cattle. papers.title: Variable transmission efficiency of mammalian origin HPAI D1.1 H5N1 strains in ferrets
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 lineage continues to predominate in the United States wild bird population and has spilled over into dairy cattle three independent times. To assess the transmission risk of this sublineage, we performed direct-contact transmission experiments for three distinct D1.1 strains in ferrets. Two of these strains were isolated from humans and one from a lethal cat infection. We found that only one human isolate (A/NV/10/2025) was able to transmit efficiently between ferrets. Compared to the other strains, this isolate harboured the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation, suggesting this mutation may be a candidate contributing to enhanced transmission efficiency of D1.1 as opposed to the PB2 E627 K substitution present in the lethal cat isolate. Based on these data, we conclude that the transmission fitness of D1.1 strains is modest, but special attention should be paid to emergence of adaptation at the PB2 701 position.

papers.title: Comparative Distribution of α2,3- and α2,6-Linked Sialic Acid Receptors and Influenza A(H5N1) Virus Binding in Sheep, Goats, and Alpacas
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 continues to pose a significant threat to animal and human health. Since 2022, an expanded host range has been observed, as illustrated by the H5N1 outbreak in dairy cows. Other minor livestock species, such as sheep, goats, and alpacas, have also tested positive for H5N1 for the first time, raising concerns about its impact on previously overlooked livestock species. In this study, we first characterized the distribution of sialic acid (SA) receptors across respiratory and non-respiratory tissues of sheep, goats, and alpacas using Maackia amurensis (SA α2,3) and Sambucus nigra (SA α2,6) lectins. We found that both SA receptors are present in all tissues across species, with notable differences in their distribution and abundance. Next, we developed recombinant LPAIV H5N1 viruses over a laboratory-adapted backbone to evaluate tissue-specific virus binding profiles. The results show that a representative H5N1 virus from clade 2.3.4.4b binds effectively to respiratory and non-respiratory tissues across all species. The strongest virus binding was observed in sheep, followed by goats and, lastly, alpacas. Similar binding patterns were observed with an LPAIV version of clade 2.3.4.4b and a Gs/Gd lineage precursor prototype virus. Finally, we show that H1N1 and H3N2 viruses also bind to respiratory tissues of sheep and goats. These findings provide important insights into the potential susceptibility of minor livestock species to HPAIV H5N1 and other influenza subtypes. Our results contribute to a better understanding of influenza tissue tropism across livestock species and its potential implications for zoonotic transmission.

papers.title_zh: 绵羊、山羊和羊驼中 α2,3- 和 α2,6- 连接唾液酸受体的比较分布和甲型 (H5N1) 流感病毒结合
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 continues to pose a significant threat to animal and human health. Since 2022, an expanded host range has been observed, as illustrated by the H5N1 outbreak in dairy cows. Other minor livestock species, such as sheep, goats, and alpacas, have also tested positive for H5N1 for the first time, raising concerns about its impact on previously overlooked livestock species. In this study, we first characterized the distribution of sialic acid (SA) receptors across respiratory and non-respiratory tissues of sheep, goats, and alpacas using Maackia amurensis (SA α2,3) and Sambucus nigra (SA α2,6) lectins. We found that both SA receptors are present in all tissues across species, with notable differences in their distribution and abundance. Next, we developed recombinant LPAIV H5N1 viruses over a laboratory-adapted backbone to evaluate tissue-specific virus binding profiles. The results show that a representative H5N1 virus from clade 2.3.4.4b binds effectively to respiratory and non-respiratory tissues across all species. The strongest virus binding was observed in sheep, followed by goats and, lastly, alpacas. Similar binding patterns were observed with an LPAIV version of clade 2.3.4.4b and a Gs/Gd lineage precursor prototype virus. Finally, we show that H1N1 and H3N2 viruses also bind to respiratory tissues of sheep and goats. These findings provide important insights into the potential susceptibility of minor livestock species to HPAIV H5N1 and other influenza subtypes. Our results contribute to a better understanding of influenza tissue tropism across livestock species and its potential implications for zoonotic transmission.

papers.title: Epidemiological characterization of avian influenza virus circulation in pigeons and quail across different production systems in Chattogram, Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Pigeons and quail contribute to poultry production, nutrition, and livelihoods in Bangladesh; however, their role in avian influenza virus (AIV) circulation remains poorly understood. These poultry species are widely reared and traded alongside chickens and ducks in household farms, commercial systems, and live bird markets, where inadequate biosecurity may create an overlooked ecological niche for AIV circulation, reassortment, and potential zoonotic spillover. Between November 2021 and April 2022, we conducted a cross-sectional study in Chattogram, Bangladesh, to estimate the prevalence and subtype-specific distribution of AIV and to identify factors associated with AIV positivity in pigeons and quail. A total of 300 birds (108 pigeons and 192 quail) were sampled from households, commercial farms, and live bird markets. Oropharyngeal and cloacal swabs were collected from each bird and tested for the AIV matrix gene using real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, followed by subtype-specific detection of H5, H7, and H9. Data collected from bird owners and traders included bird demographic characteristics, bird source, and health status using a structured questionnaire. The overall prevalence of AIV was 14.3% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 10.6–18.8). Quail had a higher prevalence (18.2%, 95% CI: 13.0–24.4) than pigeons (7.4%, 95% CI: 3.3–14.1). Among detected subtypes, H9 was most prevalent (11.3%, 95% CI: 7.9–15.4), followed by hemagglutinin (HA)-untyped (2.7%, 95% CI: 1.2–5.1) and H5 (0.3%, 95% CI: 0.001–1.8), while H7 was not detected. Quail had higher odds of AIV positivity than pigeons (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 4.1, 95% CI: 1.8–10.6); clinically sick birds (aOR = 2.9, 95% CI: 1.4–6.2) and birds sampled from household farms (aOR = 2.8, 95% CI: 1.2–6.5) also had higher odds of AIV positivity. These findings indicate that pigeons and quails, which are understudied poultry species, may contribute to the maintenance and transmission of AIV within mixed poultry production and marketing systems in Bangladesh. Integrating these species into routine AIV surveillance is therefore necessary to strengthen early detection, inform control strategies, and reduce the risk of zoonotic spillover.

papers.source_body_en: Pigeons and quail contribute to poultry production, nutrition, and livelihoods in Bangladesh; however, their role in avian influenza virus (AIV) circulation remains poorly understood. These poultry species are widely reared and traded alongside chickens and ducks in household farms, commercial systems, and live bird markets, where inadequate biosecurity may create an overlooked ecological niche for AIV circulation, reassortment, and potential zoonotic spillover. Between November 2021 and April 2022, we conducted a cross-sectional study in Chattogram, Bangladesh, to estimate the prevalence and subtype-specific distribution of AIV and to identify factors associated with AIV positivity in pigeons and quail. A total of 300 birds (108 pigeons and 192 quail) were sampled from households, commercial farms, and live bird markets. Oropharyngeal and cloacal swabs were collected from each bird and tested for the AIV matrix gene using real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, followed by subtype-specific detection of H5, H7, and H9. Data collected from bird owners and traders included bird demographic characteristics, bird source, and health status using a structured questionnaire. The overall prevalence of AIV was 14.3% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 10.6–18.8). Quail had a higher prevalence (18.2%, 95% CI: 13.0–24.4) than pigeons (7.4%, 95% CI: 3.3–14.1). Among detected subtypes, H9 was most prevalent (11.3%, 95% CI: 7.9–15.4), followed by hemagglutinin (HA)-untyped (2.7%, 95% CI: 1.2–5.1) and H5 (0.3%, 95% CI: 0.001–1.8), while H7 was not detected. Quail had higher odds of AIV positivity than pigeons (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 4.1, 95% CI: 1.8–10.6); clinically sick birds (aOR = 2.9, 95% CI: 1.4–6.2) and birds sampled from household farms (aOR = 2.8, 95% CI: 1.2–6.5) also had higher odds of AIV positivity. These findings indicate that pigeons and quails, which are understudied poultry species, may contribute to the maintenance and transmission of AIV within mixed poultry production and marketing systems in Bangladesh. Integrating these species into routine AIV surveillance is therefore necessary to strengthen early detection, inform control strategies, and reduce the risk of zoonotic spillover.

papers.title: Concurrent detection of low-pathogenic H9N2 avian influenza virus and Salmonella spp. in a poorly performing commercial layer flock in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Avian influenza virus (AIV) remains a major threat to poultry production in Bangladesh, where both highly pathogenic (HPAIV) and low-pathogenic (LPAIV) subtypes circulate. Although HPAIV is typically associated with high mortality, H9N2 LPAIV often causes mild clinical disease but has been associated with reduced egg production and economic losses in commercial poultry. This study describes the concurrent detection of H9N2 and Salmonella spp. in a 33-week-old Hy-Line Brown commercial layer flock in Moulvibazar, Bangladesh, in which a marked decline in laying performance was observed. A total of 50 birds were sampled for virological and bacteriological investigations. Oropharyngeal swabs were tested by real-time reverse transcription PCR (rRT-PCR) targeting the influenza A virus matrix (M) gene, followed by H9- and N2-specific assays. Cloacal swabs were cultured using selective enrichment and plating methods, and presumptive Salmonella spp. isolates were confirmed by PCR targeting the invA gene. Among the sampled birds, concurrent H9N2 and Salmonella spp. were detected in 11/50, while no birds were positive for H9N2 alone; Salmonella spp. alone was detected in 3/50 birds. The investigated flock exhibited markedly reduced egg production, remaining at 0% through 25 weeks of age and reaching a maximum of only 71.72% at 46 weeks, compared with the breed-standard value of 88%, while cumulative mortality reached 23.4% by 46 weeks, substantially exceeding the breed standard. These findings document the concurrent detection of H9N2 and Salmonella spp. and poor laying performance in the investigated flock. Given the single-flock design, absence of an H9N2-only comparison group and a contemporaneous healthy control flock, and incomplete assessment of other infectious and farm-level factors, the findings do not establish a causal relationship or determine whether Salmonella spp. contributed to the observed production losses. Further controlled and longitudinal studies involving multiple flocks and appropriate comparison groups are warranted to clarify the respective contributions of H9N2 and bacterial coinfections to production losses in commercial layer flocks.

Oropharyngeal swabs were tested by real-time reverse transcription PCR (rRT-PCR) targeting the influenza A virus matrix (M) gene, followed by H9- and N2-specific assays. Cloacal swabs were cultured using selective enrichment and plating methods, and presumptive Salmonella spp. isolates were confirmed by PCR targeting the invA gene. Among the sampled birds, concurrent H9N2 and Salmonella spp. were detected in 11/50, while no birds were positive for H9N2 alone; Salmonella spp. alone was detected in 3/50 birds. The investigated flock exhibited markedly reduced egg production, remaining at 0% through 25 weeks of age and reaching a maximum of only 71.72% at 46 weeks, compared with the breed-standard value of 88%, while cumulative mortality reached 23.4% by 46 weeks, substantially exceeding the breed standard. These findings document the concurrent detection of H9N2 and Salmonella spp. and poor laying performance in the investigated flock. Given the single-flock design, absence of an H9N2-only comparison group and a contemporaneous healthy control flock, and incomplete assessment of other infectious and farm-level factors, the findings do not establish a causal relationship or determine whether Salmonella spp. contributed to the observed production losses. Further controlled and longitudinal studies involving multiple flocks and appropriate comparison groups are warranted to clarify the respective contributions of H9N2 and bacterial coinfections to production losses in commercial layer flocks.

papers.title: Rapid UAV-based detection of crane (Grus grus) mortality hotspots during an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak using deep learning
papers.abstract: Rapid detection of wildlife mortality during infectious disease outbreaks is essential for ecological risk mitigation, zoonotic-risk management, and timely intervention, yet field surveys are often slow, labor-intensive, and spatially limited. This study evaluates unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery combined with deep learning as an operational surveillance tool for mapping live and deceased Common Cranes ( Grus grus ) during a highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in the Hula Valley, Israel. High-resolution RGB imagery was collected over aquatic roosting and terrestrial feeding habitats and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals. A YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning from a large avian dataset, together with selective data augmentation, sliding-window inference, and Weighted Boxes Fusion. Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. Dead cranes were detected accurately in water bodies (AP@50 ≈ 0.90), but detection in terrestrial feeding areas remained more limited (AP@50 ≈ 0.64–0.70), based on aerial annotations without in situ confirmation. Oversampling, undersampling, and focal loss provided limited improvement, suggesting that class imbalance alone does not fully explain the lower terrestrial detection performance, and that carcass scarcity, limited visual diversity, and ambiguity against heterogeneous ground backgrounds may also contribute. Joint multi-habitat training and transfer learning improved generalization for the rare dead-crane class on land. These findings demonstrate the value of UAV-based deep learning for rapid mortality assessment and hotspot identification during wildlife disease outbreaks.

High-resolution RGB imagery was collected and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals, and a YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning. The evidence supports a moderate confidence level in the effectiveness of this approach for avian influenza surveillance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在传染病暴发期间对野生动物热点区域进行快速检测对于生态风险缓解、人兽共患病风险管理和及时干预至关重要,但实地调查往往耗时、劳动密集且空间受限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了结合深度学习的无人机(UAV)图像作为一种操作性工具,用于在以色列胡拉谷地H5N1禽流感暴发期间绘制存活和死亡的普通白鹤(Grus grus)的分布情况。
elements_zh.methods: 高分辨率RGB图像在水生栖息地和陆地觅食栖息地采集,并进行标注以区分存活和死亡个体。基于YOLOv8的检测框架通过特定栖息地训练、多栖息地联合训练和从大型鸟类数据集进行的迁移学习进行了测试,同时结合选择性数据增强、滑动窗口推理和加权框融合技术。
elements_zh.main_results: 存活的白鹤在不同栖息地中被可靠检测,其在拼接觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.89,在原始觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.98。死亡的白鹤在水体中被准确检测(AP@50≈0.90),但在陆地觅食区的检测仍较为有限(AP@50≈0.64–0.70),这是基于空中标注而没有现场确认的结果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现展示了基于无人机的深度学习在野生动物疾病暴发期间进行快速热点识别和评估的价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 禽流感 暴发 的快速 监测 方法的开发提供信息,从而能够更有效地监测野生动物种群,并有可能改善人畜共患风险管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 过采样、欠采样和焦点损失提供了有限的改进,表明仅类别不平衡并不能完全解释陆地检测性能较低的原因,而尸体稀缺、视觉多样性有限以及与异质地面背景的模糊性也可能有所贡献。

papers.title: Impact of low temperature on the efficacy of chlorous acid water and sodium hypochlorite solution for inactivating avian influenza virus on material surfaces
papers.abstract: Chlorous acid water is a type of chlorine-based disinfectant with chemical properties distinct from those of sodium hypochlorite solution, which is in common use. In this study, we evaluated the inactivation efficacy of chlorous acid water against avian influenza virus deposited on material surfaces, in comparison with sodium hypochlorite solution. First, the intrinsic antiviral activity of both disinfectants was examined under conditions free of amino acids and proteins. The results demonstrated that the 99% (IC 99 ), 99.9% (IC 99.9 ), and 99.99% inhibitory concentrations (IC 99.99 ) were all approximately half those of sodium hypochlorite solution, indicating that chlorous acid water possesses slightly stronger inactivation activity. Next, the efficacy against protein-containing virus deposited on material surfaces (stainless steel, plastic, and rubber) was evaluated under conditions simulating a poultry house environment. At room temperature, both disinfectants exhibited equivalent inactivation capacity; however, a marked difference was observed under low-temperature conditions. Specifically, the efficacy of chlorous acid water was maintained or enhanced, whereas that of sodium hypochlorite solution declined, with the required concentration increasing approximately 2- to 3-fold. Taken together, these findings demonstrate that chlorous acid water exhibits antiviral activity comparable to or exceeding that of sodium hypochlorite solution, while retaining its efficacy even at low temperatures and in the presence of proteins. These properties suggest that chlorous acid water may be a particularly useful disinfectant in real-world settings such as poultry houses operating under low-temperature conditions.

analysis.methods: The intrinsic antiviral activity of both disinfectants was first tested under conditions free of amino acids and proteins. Subsequently, their efficacy was evaluated against protein-containing avian influenza virus on material surfaces under simulated poultry house conditions.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that chlorous acid water may offer comparable or superior antiviral activity to sodium hypochlorite solution, particularly under low-temperature conditions and in the presence of proteins, which is a novel insight for disinfectant efficacy in real-world settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of more effective disinfection protocols in poultry houses and other environments where low temperatures and protein contamination are common, thereby improving disease prevention and control.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,亚氯酸水可能提供与次氯酸钠溶液相当或更好的 抗病毒药物 活性,特别是在低温条件下和存在蛋白质的情况下,这是对现实环境中消毒剂功效的新见解。

papers.abstract_zh: 亚氯酸水是一种氯基消毒剂,其化学性质与常用的次氯酸钠溶液不同。在本研究中,我们与次氯酸钠溶液相比,评估了亚氯酸水对沉积在材料表面的 禽流感 病毒的灭活效果。首先,在不含氨基酸和蛋白质的条件下检查了两种消毒剂的固有 抗病毒药物 活性。结果表明,99%(IC 99 )、99.9%(IC 99.9 )和99.99%抑制浓度(IC 99.99 )均约为次氯酸钠溶液的一半,表明亚氯酸水具有稍强的灭活活性。接下来,在模拟禽舍环境的条件下评估了对沉积在材料表面(不锈钢、塑料和橡胶)上的含蛋白质病毒的功效。在室温下,两种消毒剂表现出相当的灭活能力;然而,在低温条件下观察到显着差异。具体而言,亚氯酸水的功效得以维持或增强,而次氯酸钠溶液的功效则下降,所需浓度增加约2至3倍。总而言之,这些发现表明,亚氯酸水的 抗病毒药物 活性与次氯酸钠溶液相当或超过,同时即使在低温和存在蛋白质的情况下也能保持其功效。这些特性表明,亚氯酸水可能是现实环境中特别有用的消毒剂,例如在低温条件下运行的禽舍。

papers.title: Differentiating Avian and Seasonal Influenza Viruses in Wastewater by Digital PCR
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5Nx) viruses, particularly clade 2.3.4.4b, pose substantial global health risks. We combined and piloted 2 duplex reverse transcription digital PCRs to discriminate between avian and seasonal influenza viruses in wastewater. This approach enabled rapid, strain-specific detection to reduce ambiguity in environmental surveillance for influenza viruses.

papers.title: Predicting Evolution of Avian Influenza A (H5N1)
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses have caused widespread outbreaks in avian populations, resulting in significant economic losses. Their spillover into humans and other mammalian hosts has also raised concerns about their potential public health impact. However, models for predicting the genetic evolution of HPAI H5N1 viruses in avian hosts remain limited. To address this gap, we will use only existing, publicly available viral sequence data and associated metadata from GISAID to develop and evaluate an evolutionary forecasting framework based on Beth-1. Specifically, we will estimate site-specific fitness landscapes of the hemagglutinin (HA) protein across successive influenza seasons. We will use these landscapes to predict genetic changes and select representative strains for subsequent seasons. Using historical sequence data, we will conduct retrospective season-to-season predictions. Predictive performance will be assessed by comparing the genetic similarity between selected strains and viruses observed in the corresponding subsequent seasons. This study aims to extend fitness-based evolutionary forecasting to HPAI H5N1 viruses in avian hosts, with the potential to inform vaccine strain selection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决预测禽类 宿主 中 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 病毒 进化 基因的有限模型,该模型造成了重大经济损失并引发了公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用 GISAID 的历史序列数据来开发和评估基于 Beth-1 的进化预测框架,重点关注连续流感季节的血凝素 (HA) 蛋白。
elements_zh.methods: 历史序列数据和相关元数据用于估计 HA 蛋白的位点特异性适应性景观并预测遗传变化,为随后的季节选择代表性菌株。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究将进行回顾性季节预测,并通过比较选定菌株和相应后续季节中观察到的病毒之间的遗传相似性来评估预测性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究旨在将基于适应度的进化预测扩展到禽类 宿主 中的 HPAI H5N1 病毒,并有可能为 疫苗 菌株选择提供信息。

papers.title_zh: 预测 禽流感 A (H5N1) 的 进化
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses have caused widespread outbreaks in avian populations, resulting in significant economic losses. Their spillover into humans and other mammalian hosts has also raised concerns about their potential public health impact. However, models for predicting the genetic evolution of HPAI H5N1 viruses in avian hosts remain limited. To address this gap, we will use only existing, publicly available viral sequence data and associated metadata from GISAID to develop and evaluate an evolutionary forecasting framework based on Beth-1. Specifically, we will estimate site-specific fitness landscapes of the hemagglutinin (HA) protein across successive influenza seasons. We will use these landscapes to predict genetic changes and select representative strains for subsequent seasons. Using historical sequence data, we will conduct retrospective season-to-season predictions. Predictive performance will be assessed by comparing the genetic similarity between selected strains and viruses observed in the corresponding subsequent seasons. This study aims to extend fitness-based evolutionary forecasting to HPAI H5N1 viruses in avian hosts, with the potential to inform vaccine strain selection.

papers.title: Spatial Distribution and Genetic Diversity of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A (H5N1) in Bulgaria, 2024–2026
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A (H5N1) remains an important threat to poultry production and wildlife health in Europe. This study aimed to characterise the spatial, temporal, and genetic patterns of HPAI A (H5N1) outbreaks in Bulgaria during 2024–2026. Forty-four confirmed outbreaks were analysed using spatial and molecular epidemiological approaches. Spatial aggregation was assessed using the Clark–Evans nearest-neighbour analysis, while kernel density estimation (KDE) was used to identify areas of increased outbreak concentration. DBSCAN clustering was applied to characterise spatially aggregated and geographically isolated outbreaks. Genotype data were available for 35 outbreaks, and associations of genotype with spatial group and recorded host or poultry-production category were assessed using Fisher’s exact tests. Hemagglutinin (HA) sequences were further analysed using phylogenetic reconstruction. Outbreaks demonstrated significant spatial aggregation, with the highest concentration occurring in south-central Bulgaria and a secondary hotspot in south-eastern Bulgaria. DBSCAN identified four spatial clusters and eight geographically isolated outbreaks. EA-2023-DA was the predominant genotype, accounting for 25 of the 35 genotyped outbreaks (71.4%), and showed a broad spatial and temporal distribution. Other genotypes, including EA-2021-AF, EA-2024-DF, EA-2024-DI DI.2, and EA-2024-DI DI.2.1, occurred less frequently and showed more restricted spatial distributions. Genotype composition differed significantly among DBSCAN spatial groups (Fisher’s exact test, p = 0.0152). However, the enrichment of EA-2023-DA in the largest spatial cluster was not statistically significant when analysed as a binary genotype comparison. The overall association between genotype and recorded host or production category was significant (p = 0.0357), but not after excluding unspecified poultry (p = 0.2162) or when restricted to ducks and laying hens (p = 0.7318). Overall, the findings demonstrate pronounced spatial heterogeneity in HPAI A (H5N1) outbreaks in Bulgaria, together with significant differences in genotype composition across spatial groups. The widespread detection of EA-2023-DA, alongside the occurrence of genetically distinct and more geographically restricted genotypes, indicates the concurrent circulation of multiple viral lineages. Integration of spatial, temporal, and molecular surveillance can support improved identification of areas with increased outbreak concentration and strengthen HPAI surveillance and control strategies in Bulgaria.

papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A (H5N1) remains an important threat to poultry production and wildlife health in Europe. This study aimed to characterise the spatial, temporal, and genetic patterns of HPAI A (H5N1) outbreaks in Bulgaria during 2024–2026. Forty-four confirmed outbreaks were analysed using spatial and molecular epidemiological approaches. Spatial aggregation was assessed using the Clark–Evans nearest-neighbour analysis, while kernel density estimation (KDE) was used to identify areas of increased outbreak concentration. DBSCAN clustering was applied to characterise spatially aggregated and geographically isolated outbreaks. Genotype data were available for 35 outbreaks, and associations of genotype with spatial group and recorded host or poultry-production category were assessed using Fisher’s exact tests. Hemagglutinin (HA) sequences were further analysed using phylogenetic reconstruction. Outbreaks demonstrated significant spatial aggregation, with the highest concentration occurring in south-central Bulgaria and a secondary hotspot in south-eastern Bulgaria. DBSCAN identified four spatial clusters and eight geographically isolated outbreaks. EA-2023-DA was the predominant genotype, accounting for 25 of the 35 genotyped outbreaks (71.4%), and showed a broad spatial and temporal distribution. Other genotypes, including EA-2021-AF, EA-2024-DF, EA-2024-DI DI.2, and EA-2024-DI DI.2.1, occurred less frequently and showed more restricted spatial distributions. Genotype composition differed significantly among DBSCAN spatial groups (Fisher’s exact test, p = 0.0152). However, the enrichment of EA-2023-DA in the largest spatial cluster was not statistically significant when analysed as a binary genotype comparison. The overall association between genotype and recorded host or production category was significant (p = 0.0357), but not after excluding unspecified poultry (p = 0.2162) or when restricted to ducks and laying hens (p = 0.7318). Overall, the findings demonstrate pronounced spatial heterogeneity in HPAI A (H5N1) outbreaks in Bulgaria, together with significant differences in genotype composition across spatial groups. The widespread detection of EA-2023-DA, alongside the occurrence of genetically distinct and more geographically restricted genotypes, indicates the concurrent circulation of multiple viral lineages. Integration of spatial, temporal, and molecular surveillance can support improved identification of areas with increased outbreak concentration and strengthen HPAI surveillance and control strategies in Bulgaria.

papers.title: Designing a reoriented H5 hemagglutinin to generate stem-directed, heterosubtypic immunity to influenza A viruses
papers.abstract: Human infections with the highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses highlight the risk of novel pandemics, against which seasonal vaccines provide limited cross-protection. Whereas antibody responses to current vaccine candidates are typically biased toward the immunodominant and variable head region of hemagglutinin (HA), the stem region of HA is highly conserved and targeted by broadly neutralizing antibodies. Here we describe a reoriented H5 HA (reoH5HA Phe , based on A/Vietnam/1203/2004) displayed on alum as a vaccine candidate to elicit stem-directed antibody responses and confer cross-protective immunity. We show that a single immunization with reoH5HA Phe protected naive mice against heterologous H5N1 lethal challenge (A/Texas/37/2024), and boosting with reoH5HA Phe conferred complete heterologous protection in mice pre-immunized with seasonal vaccines. The stem-directed response elicited by reoH5HA Phe also protected against heterosubtypic H1N1 challenge in both naive and pre-immune mice. Electron microscopy polyclonal epitope mapping revealed that reoH5HA Phe elicited antibodies targeting the central stem and anchor epitopes on heterologous H5 and H1 HAs, alongside antibodies against the (H5) vestigial esterase or (H1) lateral patch epitopes. Despite limited cross-neutralizing activity, increased stem-directed responses with balanced IgG1 and IgG2 subclasses reduced viral replication and improved survival. Our results highlight antigen reorientation as an effective approach for designing variant-resilient vaccines and demonstrate the potential of reoH5HA Phe as an H5 pandemic influenza vaccine candidate that confers protective immunity against both emerging and seasonal influenza viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the risk of novel pandemics caused by highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, which are not well protected by seasonal vaccines. The research highlights the need for vaccines that can elicit broadly neutralizing antibodies against conserved regions of hemagglutinin (HA) to improve cross-protection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved immunizing mice with a reoriented H5 HA vaccine candidate (reoH5HA Phe) and testing their protection against heterologous H5N1 lethal challenge. It also evaluated the effect of boosting with reoH5HA Phe in mice pre-immunized with seasonal vaccines.
analysis.methods: The researchers used electron microscopy and polyclonal epitope mapping to analyze the antibody responses elicited by reoH5HA Pfe. They assessed viral replication and survival rates in mice after immunization and challenge with different influenza strains.
analysis.main_results: A single immunization with reoH5HA Phe protected naive mice against heterologous H5N1 lethal challenge, and boosting with reoH5HA Phe conferred complete heterologous protection in mice pre-immunized with seasonal vaccines. The vaccine also elicited antibodies targeting the central stem and anchor epitopes on heterologous H5 and H1 HAs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The stem-directed response elicited by reoH5HA Phe reduced viral replication and improved survival, even with limited cross-neutralizing activity. This suggests that antigen reorientation could be a promising strategy for developing variant-resilient vaccines.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that reoH5HA Phe could serve as a potential vaccine candidate for H5 pandemic influenza, offering protection against both emerging and seasonal influenza viruses through stem-directed immunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to animal models, and the results may not directly translate to human immunity. The evidence is based on a single immunization and boosting protocol, which may not reflect real-world vaccine administration scenarios.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a vaccine candidate for avian influenza A viruses that could elicit stem-directed immunity to provide cross-protection against both seasonal and emerging strains. The researchers designed a reoriented H5 HA (reoH5HA Phe) and tested its efficacy in mice. A single immunization with reoH5HA Phe protected naive mice against H5N1 challenge, and boosting conferred complete protection in mice pre-immunized with seasonal vaccines. The vaccine also elicited antibodies against conserved stem regions of H5 and H1 HAs, reducing viral replication and improving survival. These results suggest that antigen reorientation could be a valuable strategy for creating variant-resilient vaccines. However, the study is limited to animal models and does not account for real-world vaccine administration scenarios, which may affect generalizability.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,reoH5HA Phe 可以作为 H5 大流行性流感的潜在 疫苗 候选者,通过干定向免疫提供针对新出现和季节性流感病毒的保护。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于动物模型,结果可能无法直接转化为人类免疫力。该证据基于单一免疫和加强方案,可能无法反映现实世界的 疫苗 管理场景。

papers.title: Molecular and phylogenetic characterization of the highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus detected in the Republic of Moldova
papers.abstract: Introduction The H5N1 avian influenza virus is one of the most virulent antigenic combinations, including those with zoonotic pathogenic potential. As the number of avian influenza outbreaks has increased globally, a corresponding rise in outbreaks caused by this virus has also been recorded in the Republic of Moldova. Materials and methods The descriptive study employed epidemiological, clinical and molecular biology (RT-PCR) research methods. The research material consisted of carcasses of domestic and wild birds, as well as blood serum samples collected from various regions of the republic. Identification of the influenza virus in the research material was carried out at the National Reference Laboratory Public Institution National Center for Animal, Plant Health and Food Safety (P.I. NCAPHFS) and the EU Reference Laboratory (EURL, IZSVe). The following diagnostic kits were used for virus identification: the "IndiSpin® Pathogen Kit" (QIAGEN® GmbH for INDICAL BIOSCIENCE) and the "Virotype® Influenza A RT-PCR Kit" (Germany). Results The molecular structure of HPAI A(H5N1) viruses isolated from the Republic of Moldova demonstrated the presence of genetic mutations in the PB2 protein (E627K and/or D701N) associated with viral adaptation to mammalian hosts and isolates with European H5 viruses belonging to the EA-2021-I, EA-2022-CH, EA-2022-AB, and EA-2023-DB genotypes. Conclusions The molecular characterization of HPAI A(H5N1) isolated from birds in the Republic of Moldova demonstrated the presence of genetic mutations in the PB2 protein and in the hemagglutinin protein (S133A, S154N, and T156A), which are associated with adaptation to human-type receptors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: H5N1 禽流感 病毒是毒性最强的抗原组合之一,包括具有人畜共患致病潜力的抗原组合。该研究旨在确定摩尔多瓦共和国检测到的 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) A(H5N1) 病毒的特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项描述性流行病学和分子生物学(RT-PCR)研究,涉及国内和野生鸟类的尸体以及来自摩尔多瓦共和国各个地区的血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 材料和方法包括使用诊断试剂盒,如“IndiSpin® 病原体试剂盒”和“Virotype® 甲型流感 RT-PCR 试剂盒”,在国家参考实验室和欧盟参考实验室进行病毒鉴定。
elements_zh.main_results: 从摩尔多瓦共和国分离的 HPAI A(H5N1) 病毒的分子结构表明,PB2 蛋白(E627K 和/或 D701N)中的遗传 突变 与病毒适应哺乳动物 宿主 相关,并与属于特定基因型的欧洲 H5 病毒分离。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PB2 和血凝素蛋白中存在遗传 突变,这与对人类型受体的适应有关,表明潜在的人畜共患风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以告知监测和诊断鸟类中的HPAI A(H5N1)以及潜在的人类感染风险,为公共卫生措施和未来的研究做出贡献。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到描述性方法的使用和缺乏详细统计分析的限制,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Inactivation of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (H5N1) using a combination of Hatano-RCMF and naturally strongly acidic hot spring water
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (H5N1) poses a serious threat to the global poultry industry, causing substantial economic losses while representing a significant challenge to public health and environmental hygiene [1,2]. The objective of this study was to develop a novel non-chemical water treatment technology by combining a unique Hatano Repulsive-Collision Magnetic Field (Hatano-RCMF), generated by opposing like-pole (N–N/S–S) permanent magnets, with naturally strongly acidic hot spring water, and to evaluate its physicochemical characteristics together with its virus- and pathogen-inactivating efficacy [S1-S4]. Physicochemical changes in the treated water before and after Hatano-RCMF exposure were investigated using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) analysis [S1,S2]. Biological evaluations were performed by assessing the inactivation of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (H5N1) [S1], together with representative pathogenic microorganisms, including Escherichia coli O157 [S2] and Salmonella spp. The combined treatment of Hatano-RCMF and naturally strongly acidic hot spring water induced measurable physicochemical changes in the water and demonstrated potent inactivation activity against H5N1 as well as representative pathogenic microorganisms [S1,S2]. These findings suggest that this technology represents a promising non-chemical approach for infectious disease control that may reduce dependence on conventional chemical disinfectants. The proposed system has potential applications not only in the poultry and livestock industries but also in the fields of food safety, public health, and environmental hygiene.
